profile.name: WINFRED MUMBUA MUKONZA
profile.headline: NGO program leader with 18+ years of experience delivering child-focused development, sponsorship, humanitarian response, and community resilience programs across Kenya.
profile.about:
Strategic NGO and humanitarian program leader with 18+ years of progressive experience designing, managing, and strengthening large-scale development programs across Kenya. Proven expertise spans child protection, safeguarding, sponsorship operations, gender equality, disability inclusion, WASH, education, livelihoods, resilience, and emergency response.

A seasoned leader in donor engagement, resource mobilization, staff management, budget oversight, government coordination, partnership development, and MEAL. Known for translating strategy into accountable delivery, building high-performing teams, and improving program quality in complex community settings.

Successfully led World Vision's global "Chosen Project" sponsorship model, bringing onboard 50,000+ new sponsors in three years. Brings strong credibility with government, civil society, donors, and community stakeholders, with a consistent record of compliance, timely reporting, and measurable impact for children and vulnerable communities.

Multi-sector Program Management: WASH, SRHR, Education, Livelihoods

experience.role: Country Sponsorship Manager / Program Unit Manager
bullets: Provides strategic and technical leadership for child sponsorship, community development, emergency response, child protection, gender equality, health and nutrition, education, and WASH programming.
Oversees countrywide sponsorship operations, ensuring business rules, compliance standards, safeguarding requirements, and donor accountability are met.
Revitalized sponsorship engagement, improving donor retention and child-sponsor communication through digital innovation.
Produced high-quality donor reports that met strict compliance standards, contributing to continued and increased funding.
Strengthened partnerships with government, CSOs, and community groups, enhancing program reach and impact in Kilifi County.
Contributes to Extended Country Leadership Team discussions on program strategy, risk management, resource planning, and performance oversight.
Represents Plan International in national and county-level coordination platforms, including education, gender, disaster management, youth, agriculture, and water technical working groups.
Established regular staff performance review systems, including monthly program meetings to monitor progress, expenditure, and technical support needs.

experience.role: Area Programs Manager - Machakos, Kitui & Kilifi
bullets: Oversaw large-scale development programs and sponsorship operations with an annual budget exceeding USD 2.5M across multiple counties.
Delivered integrated interventions in education, WASH, nutrition, maternal and child health, gender and disability inclusion, and child protection.
Piloted and scaled the World Vision Chosen Project in 2019, a sponsorship model that attracted over 50,000 new sponsors within three years.
Achieved over 95% implementation rate of annual plans and budgets while consistently meeting organizational targets.
Recognized nationally and regionally as Best Performing Program Manager in 2017, 2018, and 2019 for excellence in reporting, accountability, and program quality.
Secured significant grant funding through collaborative proposal development, concept development, and donor engagement.
Contributed to the development of World Vision Kenya's 2016-2020 National Strategy through community engagement and evidence generation.
Maintained strong audit performance through proactive risk mitigation and implementation of recommendations.
Facilitated major donor engagements and high-level visits for fundraising and impact reporting.
Strengthened partnerships with county governments and CSOs to advance child wellbeing outcomes.

experience.role: Community Development Motivator / Project Officer, Sponsorship
bullets: Supported implementation of community development and sponsorship programs across Makueni and Mwala.
Delivered projects in child protection, disability inclusion, community health, advocacy, and education.
Successfully implemented annual Detailed Implementation Plans while meeting donor reporting requirements.
Strengthened disability mainstreaming and child protection systems in collaboration with government ministries and stakeholders.
Enhanced community empowerment and local governance structures, improving program sustainability.
Coordinated disability programming with government agencies, including health and children's services.
Led capacity building and community empowerment initiatives at international, national, and county levels, strengthening World Vision's reputation as a credible child wellbeing actor.
